plugins.name: powerbi-playbook
plugins.description: Power BI AI readiness plus compact Tableau-migration report/model contracts. The AI skill owns descriptions, categorical domains, CustomInstructions and qnaEnabled. The migration cores preserve source intent, shipped-model binding, layer handoffs and evidence limits; they are not generic or greenfield authoring guides. General procedures require separately installed upstream skills; migration tooling, refresh/persistence and live-source proof require the host repository and are not bundled. Missing owners block affected operations.
